lesson.title: Describing Quality & Difficulty
lesson.subtitle: Easy or hard, suitable, clear, strange, and important
lesson.description: Evaluate situations and things as easy, difficult, convenient, suitable, clear, famous, useful, or important.

learning_objectives: Evaluate difficulty and clarity: 简单, 容易, 难, 清楚, and 差.
Appraise suitability, value, and fame: 方便, 合适, 有名, 有用, 重要, 可爱, 难看, 难听, and 奇怪.
Use degree words and traits: 极, 特别, 挺, 聪明, and 认真.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Evaluative adjectives and degree adverbs for judging quality, difficulty, and importance.
overview.focus: Use ……极了 for "extremely", and 挺……的 for "quite / rather".

questions.answer: Written crystal clear (写得清清楚楚).

合适 means suitable or fitting.
奇怪 means strange or odd.
认真 means serious or conscientious.

dialogue.title: Choosing a Gift and a Course
dialogue.context_en: Two friends evaluate a Chinese course and pick out a suitable gift.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你觉得这门课难不难？我怕太难了学不会。
turns.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè mén kè nán bu nán? Wǒ pà tài nán le xué bú huì.
turns.english: Do you think this course is hard? I’m afraid if it’s too hard I won’t learn it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 其实挺简单的，老师讲得特别清楚，只要认真学就很容易。
turns.pinyin: Qíshí tǐng jiǎndān de, lǎoshī jiǎng de tèbié qīngchu, zhǐyào rènzhēn xué jiù hěn róngyì.
turns.english: Actually it’s quite simple; the teacher explains especially clearly—as long as you study seriously, it’s very easy.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 那就好！对了，我想买那只可爱的小熊猫送给妹妹，你觉得合适吗？
turns.pinyin: Nà jiù hǎo! Duìle, wǒ xiǎng mǎi nà zhī kě’ài de xiǎo xióngmāo sòng gěi mèimei, nǐ juéde héshì ma?
turns.english: Good! By the way, I want to buy that cute little panda toy for my younger sister—do you think it’s suitable?

turns.speaker: B
turns.english: Extremely suitable! She’ll definitely like it.

patterns.title: Saying "extremely" with ……极了
patterns.explanation_en: Place 极了 (jíle) right after an adjective or mental verb to mean "extremely".

examples.hanzi: 今天的天气好极了，不冷也不热。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì hǎo jíle, bù lěng yě bú rè.
examples.english: Today’s weather is wonderful—neither cold nor hot.

examples.hanzi: 这本词典对初学者来说有用极了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn duì chūxuézhě lái shuō yǒuyòng jíle.
examples.english: This dictionary is extremely useful for beginners.

patterns.title: Softened praise with 挺……的
patterns.explanation_en: Wrap an adjective in 挺……的 (tǐng … de) to mean "quite / rather".

examples.hanzi: 这只小猫挺聪明的，一叫它就过来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo māo tǐng cōngmíng de, yí jiào tā jiù guòlái.
examples.english: This kitten is quite clever—it comes right over as soon as you call it.

examples.hanzi: 坐地铁去机场挺方便的。
examples.pinyin: Zuò dìtiě qù jīchǎng tǐng fāngbiàn de.
examples.english: Taking the subway to the airport is quite convenient.

model.hanzi: 这个方法很重要，而且特别有用。
model.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ hěn zhòngyào, érqiě tèbié yǒuyòng.
model.english: This method is very important, and especially useful.

substitutions.cue_en: Say that song sounds unpleasant, and that picture looks ugly.

model_answer.hanzi: 那首歌有点儿难听，那幅画也不太好看，甚至有点儿难看。
model_answer.pinyin: Nà shǒu gē yǒudiǎnr nántīng, nà fú huà yě bú tài hǎokàn, shènzhì yǒudiǎnr nánkàn.
model_answer.english: That song sounds a bit unpleasant, and that painting isn’t great—even a bit ugly.

substitutions.cue_en: Say it is strange that nobody is in the office.

model_answer.hanzi: 真奇怪，办公室里一个人都没有。
model_answer.pinyin: Zhēn qíguài, bàngōngshì lǐ yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu.
model_answer.english: How strange—there isn’t a single person in the office.

substitutions.cue_en: Say his Chinese pronunciation is not bad at all.

model_answer.hanzi: 他的汉语发音一点儿也不差。
model_answer.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ fāyīn yìdiǎnr yě bú chà.
model_answer.english: His Chinese pronunciation is not bad at all.

paragraphs.hanzi: 学校东门外有一家很有名的面馆。店面虽然不大，但味道好极了，价格也很合适。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xuéxiào dōngmén wài yǒu yì jiā hěn yǒumíng de miànguǎn. Diànmiàn suīrán bú dà, dàn wèidào hǎo jíle, jiàgé yě hěn héshì.
paragraphs.english: Outside the east gate of the school there is a very famous noodle shop. Although the storefront isn’t big, the taste is terrific and the price is very reasonable.

paragraphs.hanzi: 老板做事特别认真，菜单写得清清楚楚。大家觉得来这里吃饭既方便又实惠，所以每天中午人都很多。
paragraphs.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zuòshì tèbié rènzhēn, càidān xiě de qīngqīngchǔchǔ. Dàjiā juéde lái zhèlǐ chīfàn jì fāngbiàn yòu shíhuì, suǒyǐ měitiān zhōngwǔ rén dōu hěn duō.
paragraphs.english: The owner works especially conscientiously, and the menu is written crystal clear. Everyone feels eating here is both convenient and affordable, so it’s crowded every noon.

questions.prompt_en: Where is the famous noodle shop located?
questions.answer_en: Outside the east gate of the school.

questions.prompt_en: Why is it crowded every noon?
questions.answer_en: Because the food tastes great, the price is reasonable, the owner is conscientious, and eating there is convenient and affordable.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Recommend a book, app, or place using 有用, 方便, or 极了.

model_answer.hanzi: 这本词典有用极了，查生词特别方便。
model_answer.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn yǒuyòng jíle, chá shēngcí tèbié fāngbiàn.
model_answer.english: This dictionary is extremely useful—looking up new words is especially convenient.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe a friend or classmate using 聪明 and 认真.

model_answer.hanzi: 我同桌既聪明又认真，每次作业都写得特别好。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ tóngzhuō jì cōngmíng yòu rènzhēn, měi cì zuòyè dōu xiě de tèbié hǎo.
model_answer.english: My deskmate is both clever and conscientious; every homework assignment is written especially well.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 难看 ("ugly / unpleasant to look at") and 难听 ("unpleasant to hear") follow the pattern 难 + verb, just like 难吃 ("tastes bad") and 好吃 / 好看 / 好听.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 清楚 (qīngchu) and 聪明 (cōngming) both often take a light neutral tone on the second syllable in connected speech.
